fields.statement: Scope restated by plan review (milestone 40, finding f1): {run_tmp} is already removed when a run ends (internal/run/engine.go defer, and on abandon internal/api/run.go). The gap this change set builds is that a run's agents and commands write to the shared tmp unless the workflow's [env] sets TMPDIR = "{run_tmp}": the daemon sets TMPDIR to {run_tmp} for every process a run's steps start unless [env] sets TMPDIR itself. Retiring the tmpsweep unit also needs bug 01M7M3JZFW (the projection leak). See done point m40-run-tmp.
